projects.label: Prometeo · crecimiento autónomo
projects.goal: Convert durable returns into useful successor work and successive generations without human routing, while preserving verification and authority boundaries.

jobs.title: Cerrar un ciclo productivo G2 → G3 con evidencia durable
jobs.mission: Tomar el compounding frontier actual, identificar el bloqueo exacto que impide que trabajo derivado de G2 se ejecute y produzca G3, implementar o desbloquear el siguiente paso permitido y dejar receipts verificables.
definition_of_done: Existe evidencia durable de consumo del resultado previo.
Se crea o activa trabajo sucesor sin diseño manual ad hoc del humano.
El sucesor se ejecuta o queda bloqueado por una frontera exacta y demostrada, no por falta de routing.
No se declara autonomía global sin verificador independiente.

latest_return.summary: Closed the recovered G2->G3 portfolio seed after its PARTIAL checkpoint. The independent compounding verifier's hardened-ledger and replayability blockers were implemented in scripts/build-planner-source-from-ledger.mjs with falsification tests. A deduplicated successor was materialized, claimed, executed, and returned DONE: exact RETURN hashes plus validated ledgers now reproduce G2, execute its generated VERIFY, and emit a deterministic READY_DERIVED G3 opportunity through the same adapter+compiler path without human task wording or authority promotion.

jobs.latest_pin_recovery_basis: Legacy claim has no pin, no RETURN, no worker heartbeat directory, and no durable signal for >10 minutes; migrate through deterministic G000001 recovery pin under PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1.

jobs.title: Atacar el compilador de presión contra un snapshot vivo del repo
jobs.mission: Independently attack the new frontier-pressure compiler on a fresh repository snapshot using the persisted implementation bytes. Exercise its live-filesystem path, verify terminal/live-owned/stale classifications and guide signals against durable evidence, fail closed on malformed state, and materialize a bounded repair/verification successor only if a concrete weakness is found. Do not change product authority or production /w.
definition_of_done: A fresh main repository snapshot is recorded with exact source head/hash evidence.
The persisted scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs bytes execute against that snapshot rather than only synthetic fixtures.
Observed frontier/launch/ownership/return signals are reconciled with exact durable refs and obvious misclassification is checked.
Malformed or ambiguous evidence does not silently become claimable/active authority.
Any concrete software-solvable weakness found becomes one deduplicated bounded successor; otherwise the return records independent PASS evidence and residual limits.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.

latest_return.summary: G4 closes the critic's exact-live-snapshot requirement. The current persisted frontier-pressure compiler was executed on an exact GitHub Actions checkout at SHA 09e6e7d0358ca3b491784268339b146a57bbcc0c with exit 0; executor 3/3, compiler 8/8, dedupe 7/7, superseded-owner 3/3 and efficiency ratchet all passed, and the durable canary reconciled PASS. The earlier superseded-generation liveness defect is fixed and now included in exact-snapshot CI. A separate concrete routing-scope weakness was identified: repository-wide historical opportunity queue roots can inflate claimable metrics even when those rows are not allocator-routable. One deduplicated successor was created for routable-scope parity. No product authority was promoted.

jobs.title: Reponer frontier bajo presión concurrente
jobs.mission: Reload the newly saturated worker frontier and materialize only grounded parallel work that can execute without colliding with live owners. Prefer an independent executable verification/oracle lane around newly created allocator/metabolism mechanisms rather than duplicating their implementation.
definition_of_done: Current live owners and terminal work are rechecked before materializing successors.
At least one bounded non-duplicate implementation, verification or integration job is created when evidence supports it.
Created work can run independently of the live implementation owner and has explicit acceptance criteria.
A durable guide receipt records trigger evidence, created jobs and any real boundary.

latest_return.summary: FRONTIER_THIN planning cycle completed without colliding with active universal-swarm, generic planner or frontier-compiler owners. Materialized one independent executable verification lane: frontier-pressure oracle fixtures, designed to validate launch-pressure, dedupe, terminal, liveness and stale-recovery decisions without sharing compiler implementation logic.

jobs.title: Hacer robustos los CREATE append-only bajo main concurrente
jobs.mission: Implement and test a reusable control-plane helper/protocol path for append-only create-if-absent writes under heavy concurrent movement of main. It must distinguish an unrelated branch-head/CAS conflict from a true deterministic-path collision: refresh head and retry the same path only when the path is still absent; if the path exists, treat it as the authoritative lost race. Preserve pin/claim authority semantics and never overwrite existing evidence.
definition_of_done: A reusable executable helper or narrowly integrated implementation exists for append-only deterministic creates used by worker beacons/pins/receipts.
Tests cover unrelated main-head movement followed by successful retry of the same absent path.
Tests cover true path-exists collision and prove no variant path or duplicate execution claim is created.
No existing append-only evidence is updated or overwritten; compare-and-swap/preserve-first rules remain intact.
At least one current /wc write path is exercised with machine-auditable evidence.

latest_return.summary: Post-claim validation found the allocator recovery hint stale: generation 1 had already implemented the reusable append-only create retry helper, added tests and durable evidence, and reported 5/5 passing. No substantive hot-path mutation was made by generation 2. This terminal return closes duplicate recovery without redoing completed work.

jobs.title: No reabrir por edad trabajos que esperan autoridad nueva
jobs.mission: Introducir una señal durable y fail-closed para trabajos cuyo último resultado exige autoridad humana/durable nueva antes de continuar, de modo que elapsed-time replaceability no regenere ownership inútil. La reapertura debe requerir evidencia posterior que satisfaga explícitamente esa autoridad, no sólo tiempo.
definition_of_done: Existe una representación estructurada de AUTHORITY_DEBT/NEW_AUTHORITY_GATE en returns o estado derivado, separada de SOURCE_DEBT y de fallas de transporte.
Un latest return con esa señal no se ofrece como recovery por edad solamente.
Una evidencia durable posterior que satisfaga la autoridad requerida permite reapertura acotada y conserva la procedencia del boundary previo.
Regression reproduce portfolio-facultad-discover-then-bind-canonical-identity-v1: G5 no genera G6 sin autoridad nueva.
Jobs retry-safe sin authority boundary mantienen recovery normal; señales ambiguas fallan cerradas sin declarar completion.

latest_return.summary: Implemented a durable NEW_AUTHORITY_GATE distinct from SOURCE_DEBT/transport failure. OPEN or malformed gates fail closed into recovery attention; SATISFIED requires later existing durable evidence; reopened PINs preserve boundary/satisfaction provenance. The Facultad G5 regression now suppresses G6 in the live allocator while ordinary retry-safe recovery remains unchanged. Canonical CI and ratchet passed.

jobs.title: Make frontier pressure capability-aware without changing claim authority
jobs.mission: Extend the allocator/metabolism projection so FRONTIER_THIN/LOW_YIELD evidence distinguishes total clean frontier from candidates compatible with generic repository-capable /wc workers versus specialized browser/mobile/host/dispatch capability buckets. Derive this only from already-compiled required_capabilities; add no preclaim reads, do not suppress specialized work, do not weaken deterministic POOL sharding, and do not manufacture filler jobs.
definition_of_done: Allocator/live evidence publishes total clean frontier plus a generic-compatible count and bounded specialized capability buckets derived from candidate.required_capabilities.
Generic-compatible classification is deterministic from allocator metadata and treats unknown capability as unknown rather than absent.
A fixture matching the 2026-09-18 PROD-01 shape proves browser/mobile/host/dispatch-only candidates do not inflate the generic-compatible count.
Guide planner/rescate evidence can cite the capability-aware pressure signal without requiring disposable workers to read extra preclaim context.
Existing claim authority, three-attempt bound, capability filtering and POOL sharding semantics remain unchanged.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.

latest_return.summary: Post-claim implementation was prepared against current main twice through ordinary CAS and once as an exact Git blob/tree/commit, but concurrent main movement prevented a non-forced fast-forward. The prepared commit 0c8d2b8bfb54a9df0ffa60345299b3c9e3ce3405 is not referenced by main and MUST NOT be treated as applied. No force push, overwrite, claim-authority change or partial allocator mutation was performed.

jobs.title: Make batched /wc contention barriers admit their exact contender cohort
jobs.mission: Repair the canary allocator/routing path so an explicit timing-only contention barrier can admit exactly required_contenders distinct workers from a batched /wc wave, while nonparticipants reallocate immediately. Preserve deterministic PIN authority, no-authority entrant/RELEASE semantics, fixed-generation fixtures, ordinary-job zero barrier cost, and all existing efficiency-ratchet constraints.
definition_of_done: For a deterministic test wave BATCH EXPECTED 10 with one open barrier requiring 5 contenders, exactly five distinct workers become admitted barrier participants through durable timing-only coordination; the remaining five do not wait and re-enter normal allocation.
Before valid RELEASE none of the admitted workers attempts the portfolio PIN.
One no-authority RELEASE names exactly the admitted cohort; those five race the exact fixed G000001 PIN, yielding exactly one winner claim and four prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipts.
Late/extra workers cannot inflate the collision count or join after cohort closure; timeout still records pin_attempted=false and forbids late release/PIN.
Ordinary portfolio candidates preserve the existing batched unified sharding behavior and incur no extra barrier coordination.
Add regression coverage exercising the full batch-sharding-to-barrier-fan-in path, not only routePortfolioCandidate in isolation.
Run the efficiency ratchet check and the relevant contention/barrier tests.
Do not promote production /w, Current, Human Accepted or Served.

latest_return.summary: Recovered stale G000001 work without rewriting product code. Canonical main already contains batch-wide contention fan-in, exact canonical RELEASE cohort handling, release-membership-gated deterministic PIN routing, compact-frontier publication and end-to-end 10-to-5 regression coverage. A successful current Live Feed CI run passed the barrier/fan-in/fixed-generation/sharding tests, and a successful Efficiency Ratchet run passed static non-regression including the ratchet checker. No production /w, Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion was performed.

jobs.title: Integrar barrera de contención con fixture de generación fija
jobs.mission: Verify the end-to-end integration between explicit contention barriers and fixed-generation ownership semantics. A barrier-enabled generation-fixed fixture must rendezvous before PIN, RELEASE all valid entrants onto the same declared generation, record normal loser collisions, resolve fixed_generation_attention when the declared evidence threshold is satisfied, and never manufacture ordinary G+1 ownership. Ordinary non-barrier and retry-safe jobs must retain their existing behavior.
definition_of_done: A barrier-enabled fixed-generation fixture exposes a timing-only pre-PIN barrier action and does not expose PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE before valid RELEASE.
After RELEASE, distinct entrants target the same declared fixed generation and exactly one PIN authority wins; losers create durable collision evidence and no execution authority.
When the fixed acceptance threshold is reached, fixed_generation_attention resolves without exposing G+1 ordinary recovery for that fixture.
Barrier timeout produces no PIN attempt and no false fixed-generation completion.
Ordinary jobs without barrier metadata remain direct-to-PIN, and ordinary retry-safe jobs preserve next-generation recovery.
Regression coverage is generic and metadata-driven; no fixture job-id blacklist is introduced.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.

latest_return.summary: Verified and CI-guarded the end-to-end composition of explicit contention barriers with metadata-driven fixed-generation ownership. A fresh fixed fixture compiles to its declared G000001, barrier routing withholds that PIN until RELEASE, RELEASE preserves the same fixed generation, timeout attempts no PIN, incomplete fixed evidence remains FIXED_GENERATION_RECONCILE attention without G+1, the 4-collision threshold resolves attention, and ordinary retry-safe recovery still advances to G+1. No live fixture window, production /w, Current, Served or Human Accepted authority was created.

jobs.title: Audit fixed-generation contention fixtures before live races
jobs.mission: Statically audit the live fixed-generation contention fixtures and their compiler/tests before spending more multi-worker race capacity. Verify quorum/release exactness, no pre-release PIN, fixed G000001 targeting, timeout pin_attempted=false, loser collision/no-claim semantics and recovery-policy alignment across race-2 and race-5 v2/v3. Patch only bounded repository-local defects; do not manufacture entrants or claim live contention success.
definition_of_done: Inspect the race-2 and race-5 v2/v3 derived jobs, their barrier/recovery definitions, CONTENTION_START_BARRIER_CANDIDATE_V1.json, scripts/apply-fast-allocator-contention-barriers.mjs and fast_allocator_contention_barrier_routing_v1.mjs.
Verify statically that RELEASE grants no execution authority, exact released cohort rules are preserved, and no PIN is legal before RELEASE.
Verify all fixed-generation fixtures target only G000001 and timeout paths record pin_attempted=false without manufacturing G000002+ recovery.
Verify loser behavior requires collision evidence and forbids authoritative execution claims.
Run bounded repository tests when available; patch only repository-local defects with regression evidence, otherwise record STATIC_CONTRACT_OK.
Leave genuine simultaneous GitHub contention as the explicit remaining live boundary.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion.

latest_return.summary: Static audit found and repaired contract drift only: binding allocator/tests require an exact canonical release cohort and membership-gated G000001 race, while older candidate/fixture prose permitted broader entrant interpretation. No runtime hot-path logic changed. Fixed-generation recovery, no-authority RELEASE, timeout pin_attempted=false and loser collision/no-claim semantics remain intact.

jobs.title: Integrar barrera de contención verificada al protocolo binding
jobs.mission: Independently verify the committed contention barrier test plus the real two-worker GitHub canary, then integrate the smallest authority-safe barrier/rendezvous contract into binding worker/portfolio allocation protocol. Entrant and RELEASE receipts must remain timing-only; normal portfolio jobs must remain unchanged; barrier mode must be explicit to multi-party canary jobs. Also bind a Live projection contract for waiting/released/winner/collision/timeout states. Do not promote production /w.
definition_of_done: Independent replay of coordination/portfolio/tests/contention_start_barrier_v1.mjs passes from the committed blob.
Real canary evidence proves two distinct entrants, no-authority RELEASE, one deterministic pin winner, one matching claim, one genuine loser collision receipt and no loser claim.
Binding protocol changes are surgical and explicitly preserve PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL authority: entrant/RELEASE never grant execution authority.
Barrier/rendezvous mode is opt-in for explicit multi-party contention fixtures; ordinary portfolio allocation does not wait on barriers.
Timeout semantics guarantee no pin attempt before quorum and re-entry instead of deadlock.
Live projection contract defines WAITING_FOR_CONTENDERS, RELEASED_TO_RACE, winner, collision loser and timeout without overriding durable evidence.
Tests or validation evidence cover backward compatibility with normal deterministic pin races.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion is inferred.

latest_return.summary: Independently replayed the committed contention barrier and ordinary deterministic pin race, verified the real two-worker GitHub canary artifact-by-artifact, then integrated an explicit opt-in timing-only barrier into PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1 v1.2 and bound a Live projection contract for waiting/released/winner/collision/timeout states. Ordinary portfolio allocation remains direct-to-pin unless durable fixture metadata explicitly opts into barrier mode.

jobs.title: Implementar barrera durable de contendientes para canaries de PIN
jobs.mission: Implement a reusable append-only contention-start barrier for isolated exclusive-PIN canaries so multiple distinct /wc workers can durably arm before racing the same deterministic pin path. Barrier registration must not grant execution authority, timeout/abandon must fail safely without blocking normal allocation, and release must require the fixture's configured distinct entrant count without human timing.
definition_of_done: Distinct workers can append entrant receipts to one isolated fixture without receiving execution authority.
Release becomes eligible only when the configured number of distinct valid entrants is durably present.
After release, entrants still race the ordinary deterministic PIN path; the barrier never selects or grants a winner.
Duplicate entrant receipts from the same worker do not satisfy the distinct-worker threshold.
Timeout/abandon state is explicit and cannot deadlock unrelated allocation.
Deterministic tests cover at least 2-worker and 5-worker release, duplicate entrant suppression, and timeout behavior.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w pointer is changed.

latest_return.summary: Implemented a reusable durable contention-start barrier for isolated exclusive-PIN canaries. Distinct workers register append-only BARRIER_ENTRANT_ONLY receipts before the race; the evaluator releases only after the configured distinct-worker threshold, never selects a winner, and times out safely without blocking unrelated allocation. The persisted module and tests match the locally tested bytes; 5/5 deterministic Node tests pass. A protocol document defines atomic CREATE paths, fail-closed receipt validation, ARMING/RELEASED/TIMED_OUT semantics and the requirement that a real canary still prove one ordinary deterministic PIN winner plus at least one genuine loser collision receipt.

jobs.title: Live fixed-G1 barrier pin race · 2 workers
jobs.mission: Run the smallest real GitHub-backed end-to-end canary for the explicit contention barrier plus fixed-generation ownership path. Two distinct /wc workers must register as timing-only entrants before deadline, obtain one no-authority RELEASE, then race the same deterministic G000001. Exactly one worker wins execution authority; the loser writes one normal portfolio pin-collision receipt, creates no execution claim, and re-enters allocation. The winner may return DONE only after the required loser collision is durably visible; otherwise return PARTIAL without manufacturing G000002.
definition_of_done: Exactly two distinct entrant worker_ids exist before the barrier deadline.
Exactly one valid RELEASE exists with grants_execution_authority=false and next_action=RACE_DETERMINISTIC_PIN.
No G000001 PIN attempt occurs before valid RELEASE.
After RELEASE both entrants target the same deterministic G000001 and exactly one PIN wins.
Exactly one prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipt exists for attempted_generation=1 and that loser created no execution claim.
The authoritative winner return plus collision_count>=1 resolves fixed_generation_attention and no ordinary G000002 recovery is exposed.
Timeout without quorum produces no PIN attempt and no false completion.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.

jobs.title: Run live 2/5-worker portfolio pin contention canary
jobs.mission: Verify the deterministic portfolio pin protocol against real GitHub-backed simultaneous /wc contention. Exercise 2-worker and 5-worker same-job/same-generation races, durable loser collision receipts, loser re-entry, recovery-generation predecessor lineage and Live projection. Do not change product surfaces or promote production /w.
definition_of_done: A live 2-worker same-job/same-generation contention produces exactly one winning pin and one prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipt; loser creates no execution claim and re-enters allocation.
A live 5-worker same-job/same-generation contention produces exactly one winning pin and four durable loser collision receipts; losers create no duplicate execution claims and re-enter allocation.
A live recovery-generation contention preserves predecessor_pin_ref and still yields exactly one winner plus durable loser receipts.
